children: GB CORP- BOARD APPROVES PROVISION OF FINANCIAL SUPPORT TO GB AUTO TANZANIA, TO SUPPORT BORROWER'S OPERATIONS AND BUSINESS ACTIVITIES
GB CORP- OARD CONFIRMS FUNDING SHALL CONSTITUTE LOANS PROVIDED BY GB CORP TO GB AUTO TANZANIA
GB CORP- LOAN SHALL BEAR INTEREST ON OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL AT THE RATE OF 7% PER ANNUM (FIXED), ACCRUING DAILY FROM DISBURSEMENT DATE
GB CORP- GB CORP HAS RIGHT TO UTILIZE LOAN AMOUNT FOR PURPOSE OF INCREASING ITS EQUITY PARTICIPATION IN GB AUTO TANZANIA
